summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Goldman Sachs Growth Opportunities ETF (GSGO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF investing in stocks of US companies of any market capitalization. Positions are selected and weighted based on the proprietary growth and valuation metrics GSGO was launched on Nov 17, 2025 and is issued by Goldman Sachs.

holdings.infoBox: GSGO is an equity ETF with a total of 55 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 12.54%, Alphabet at 12.14%, Microsoft at 7.15%, Advanced Micro Devices at 4.44%, and Meta Platforms at 4.37%.
